chars.YOUSSEF: YOUSSEF: a young Moroccan man wearing a bright red hoodie and black jogging trousers.
chars.MARIA: MARIA: a young Brazilian woman wearing a yellow and green striped summer dress and small gold hoop earrings.
chars.RAHUL: RAHUL: an Indian man wearing a long white kurta shirt and beige trousers.
chars.POLICE: POLICE: an Indian police officer wearing a khaki uniform, a khaki beret, a black belt and a thick moustache drawn on the white face, holding a long wooden stick.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night in a small apartment living room in Mumbai. YOUSSEF and MARIA sit together on a sofa in front of a glowing TV, MARIA smiling cheekily at YOUSSEF, YOUSSEF looking nervous and stiff. RAHUL stands behind the sofa with raised eyebrows and an awkward grin, holding car keys. Comic awkward mood.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Same Mumbai apartment living room at night. RAHUL politely points toward the front door offering to leave them alone, MARIA sitting on the sofa waves her hand 'no no' with a big friendly smile.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: On the sofa in front of the TV at night: YOUSSEF sits very straight at the far end of the sofa like a polite schoolboy with hands on his knees, sweating, while MARIA leans close to him flirtatiously resting her head near his shoulder. Funny awkward contrast.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Dark bedroom at 2 am lit by blue moonlight. YOUSSEF jolts upright in bed, eyes wide in shock, staring toward the bedroom door because of loud banging. A clock on the wall shows night. Suspense.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Apartment front door opened at night in a dim corridor. Two POLICE officers stand in the doorway with stern faces and stick in hand; YOUSSEF in the doorway in his red hoodie looks terrified, hand on the door handle.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: At the apartment doorway at night, a POLICE officer leans forward suspiciously looking YOUSSEF up and down, one finger raised as if questioning him; YOUSSEF smiles nervously, scratching the back of his head.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Apartment entrance at night: MARIA steps out of the bedroom wrapped in a blanket over her striped dress, looking shocked; YOUSSEF stands beside her embarrassed; a POLICE officer at the door points at her demanding answers.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: In the apartment entrance at night: the POLICE officer shakes his finger angrily at YOUSSEF and MARIA, who stand side by side looking panicked, MARIA holding YOUSSEF's arm.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Night corridor outside the apartment: two POLICE officers grab YOUSSEF by the arms and pull him toward the stairs, YOUSSEF looks back over his shoulder in pure panic. Dramatic suspense.
